how_to_apply: Visit the bank's official careers website: ib.tmbonline.bank.in/tmb_careers/
Read the detailed advertisement by clicking "Download Advertisement" under the relevant post title, and confirm your eligibility before applying.
Click "Apply Online" and register yourself for the appropriate post using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.

On successful registration, an activation link will be sent to your registered email ID, and a Registration Number and Password will be sent to your registered mobile number. Note these carefully, as they are required to proceed further.
Click the activation link sent to your email ID to be directed to the Careers portal.

Log in using your Application/Registration Number and Password, and fill in all details carefully, clicking "Save/Continue" on every page. Ensure your name and your father's/husband's name are spelt exactly as per your certificates/mark sheets.
Upload your photograph and signature as per the specified dimensions and file size.
Upload the required enclosures: SSLC/Higher Secondary certificate, Degree certificate, Experience certificate/Relieving letter, and Last month's salary slip.
Click "Confirm/Submit" at the bottom of the page. A message "Registration is successful" will be displayed on successful submission.
A copy of the system-generated application form will be sent to your registered email ID. Take a printout for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications will be accepted only through the online mode; no other mode of submission will be accepted. Register your correct email ID and mobile number while creating your User ID. Keep your personal email ID and contact number active till completion of the recruitment project, as call letters may be sent on the registered email ID. Any change or alteration found in the name of the candidate or their father/husband as per certificates may disqualify the candidature. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The job role and location are subject to transfer based on the bank's requirements; posting will be anywhere in India. E-applications with incorrect or incomplete particulars, or without the required certificate copies, are liable to be rejected. The bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate an ineligible candidate, at any stage of the process without assigning any reason. The bank's decision on eligibility, interview, and selection is final.

Candidates interested in similar opportunities can also explore other Private Sector Bank Jobs and Banking and Finance Jobs across India. Those with experience in trade finance can check more Trade Finance Jobs, while candidates interested in relationship management roles can browse Relationship Manager Jobs. Retired bank officers looking for contract-based opportunities can also explore more Retired Officer Jobs and Bank Inspection and Audit Jobs matching their experience.

content_sections.heading: TMB Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements differ for each post. Detailed criteria are given below. Cadre: Manager / Assistant Manager Educational Qualification: Any Graduation or Post Graduation in first class (60% marks) in any discipline under a regular stream from a recognised university. Age Limit: Not more than 35 years as on 30.06.2026 Experience: For Manager - at least 3 years of relevant experience in a bank in sourcing / processing loans / MSME loans / retail loans. For Assistant Manager - at least 2 years of relevant experience in the same areas. Tenor: Regular basis Other Condition: No vigilance case or adverse observation from RBI/Statutory Authority should be pending against the candidate. Cadre: Manager / Senior Manager Age Limit: Minimum 28 years and not more than 38 years as on 30.06.2026 (age may be relaxed in deserving cases). Educational Qualification: Any Graduate / Post Graduate from a recognised university under a regular curriculum. Holding a Certified Credit Professional certification and a certification in Foreign Exchange Operations by IIBF is desirable. Experience: At least three years of experience in handling Trade Finance business. Tenor: Regular basis Other Condition: No vigilance case or adverse observation from DAC/Vigilance/RBI/Statutory Authority should be pending against the candidate. Age Limit: Not more than 62 years as on 30.06.2026 Who Can Apply: Retired officers of TMB or other banks are eligible for selection from the date of retirement. Cadre at Retirement: Officers must have retired in Scale II, Scale III, or Scale IV cadre. Preference will be given to those with previous work experience in the inspection/audit department. Track Record: Only suitable persons with a good track record and unblemished service are eligible. Disqualification: Officers removed or dismissed from bank service under disciplinary measures are not eligible. Contract Period: Initially engaged for 1 year, renewable for a further 1 year based on satisfactory performance (total 2 years).

content_sections.heading: TMB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is common for all three posts: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview. The interview will be conducted through Direct mode or Video Conferencing. The mode, date, and time of the interview will be communicated to eligible candidates individually. The bank's decision on eligibility, interview, and selection will be final.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Build and maintain strong customer relationships and acquire new customers. Promote and cross-sell banking products such as CASA, loans, insurance, and investment products. Achieve assigned sales and business targets. Ensure KYC compliance, handle customer portfolio management, and coordinate onboarding. Assess customer background and risk using CIBIL, CRILC, and Account Aggregator tools. Conduct property and collateral verification using Proplegit for home loans. Visit accounts in SMA 0, 1, and 2 categories along with the collection officer. Act as the primary point of contact for trade finance customers in the region. Facilitate onboarding of new trade finance clients in compliance with regulatory policies. Provide expertise on letters of credit (LCs), bank guarantees, documentary bills collection, trade loans, and export/import financing. Cross-sell cash management, foreign exchange, and treasury solutions. Evaluate creditworthiness and assess risks associated with trade finance transactions. Oversee preparation and verification of trade finance documents for accuracy and compliance. Assist internal and external auditors during trade finance reviews. Verify that branch activities comply with the bank's internal policies, RBI regulations, and statutory requirements. Check compliance with KYC and AML norms and scrutinise cash transactions for irregularities. Examine loan and advance portfolios, verify cash balance and vault holdings. Identify operational, credit, trade finance, and compliance risks; check for fraud-prone areas. Inspect pledged/mortgaged security items such as gold and title deeds, and verify CCTV/alarm/fire safety systems. Prepare detailed inspection reports covering observations, irregularities, risks, and recommendations. Submit findings to the Regional Office/Head Office Inspection Division and follow up on earlier recommendations.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for TMB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following self-attested documents along with the online application: Self-attested photo copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate for age proof. Self-attested photo copy of Degree Certificate(s). Experience certificate(s) and Relieving Letter for previous employments. Last month's salary slip. Signatures in capital letters will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to register the online e-application for Relationship Manager, Product Specialist (Trade Finance), and Mobile Inspector of Branches posts is 03.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. Is there an application fee for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, the application fee is Nil for all three posts advertised under TMB Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the TMB Relationship Manager post?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be more than 35 years of age as on 30.06.2026 to apply for the Relationship Manager post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for TMB Product Specialist (Trade Finance)?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 28 years and not more than 38 years of age as on 30.06.2026, though the age may be relaxed in deserving cases.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for TMB Mobile Inspector of Branches?
faq.answer: Retired officers of TMB or other banks who retired in Scale II, Scale III, or Scale IV cadre with an unblemished service record are eligible to apply, subject to a maximum age of 62 years as on 30.06.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the TMB Mobile Inspector of Branches post?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of ₹35,000/- per month, along with lodging expenses and halting allowance as applicable to the respective cadre. Bonus, ex-gratia, variable pay, LFC, and medical reimbursement are not payable.
